targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(telemetry_continuity_pct)*100 FROM operational_validation_windows GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(replay_backlog_trend_slope) FROM telemetry_trend_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(fatigue_score) FROM analyst_behavior_trends GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(fp_trend_slope) FROM false_positive_evolution_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(cpu_trend_slope) FROM infrastructure_stability_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT AVG(replay_success_rate_pct)*100 FROM replay_durability_history WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(avg_storage_pressure_pct)*100 FROM infrastructure_stability_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at), AVG(composite_drift_score) FROM operational_drift_history GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance_reporting_runs WHERE governance_verdict = 'pass' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
